document_metadata.title: 14、EXT. SKY DAY
document_metadata.summary: Sam defeats the horde, moves toward the cage to rescue the girl, but a dark, laughing cloud of black shapes rises and flies away; he hesitates to pursue when a ringing phone confuses him.

relations.subject: prototype radio controlled camera
relations.object: Surveillance camera invades Jill's personal space
relations.description: The prototype radio controlled camera moves close to Jill's face, which constitutes an invasion of her personal space; she reacts by swatting it. The camera is the agent performing the action, but the relation as stated frames the event from the perspective of the subject undergoing the spatial intrusion. Thus, 'undergoes' correctly captures that the camera is the entity being described as acting upon Jill, with the invasion as the event it undergoes in relation to her. However, given the semantics of 'undergoes' as applying to entities that are acted upon, and since the camera is the actor, this requires flipping the interpretation: the subject phrase describes an action the camera performs, not undergoes. Therefore, no valid allowed relation fits without reversing roles. But since we cannot change subject/object, and 'performs' is disallowed, and no allowed relation supports the camera as actor, the only defensible fix is to drop.

relations.subject: prototype radio controlled camera
relations.object: Jill swats surveillance camera with forms
relations.description: The subject 'Jill swats surveillance camera with forms' describes an action initiated by Jill, who actively swats the prototype radio controlled camera. The verb 'swats' indicates a direct, transient action performed by the subject on the object, making 'performs' the correct relation type. The event is fleeting and tied to a single moment in the scene, warranting 'momentary' persistence.

document_metadata.title: 19、INT. POSH RESTAURANT (ENTRANCE) DAY
document_metadata.summary: SAM rejects his promotion to Information Retrieval, throws the notice, and declares he wants nothing, not even dreams, as chaos ensues and a screen is set up around the table.

entities.name: Sam requests a rare steak at the restaurant
entities.description: Sam brusquely orders a rare steak from Spiro, refusing to engage with the numbered menu system by handing it back and stating he does not care which number corresponds to his order.

entities.name: Spiro announces Shirley's order as number one
entities.description: Spiro declares that Shirley's dish is 'numero une' and serves her crevettes la mayonnaise, placing it in front of her with ceremonial flair.

entities.name: Spiro serves Mother her braised veal in wine sauce
entities.description: Spiro identifies and delivers the dish ordered by Sam's mother as 'numero huit', presenting her with braised veal in wine sauce despite her earlier hesitation about dieting.

entities.name: Spiro delivers Mrs. Terrain's duck a l'orange
entities.description: Spiro places the dish corresponding to 'numero deux' in front of Mrs. Terrain, identifying it as duck a l'orange with theatrical precision.

entities.name: Mrs. Terrain reveals she has switched doctors
entities.description: Mrs. Terrain excitedly announces to the group that she has left Dr. Jaffe and is now under the care of Dr. Chapman, praising his revolutionary techniques involving acid treatments.

entities.name: Mother expresses regret for criticizing Dr. Chapman
entities.description: After making a dismissive comment about Dr. Chapman being the 'acid man', Sam's mother apologizes to Mrs. Terrain for sounding judgmental about her treatment choice.

entities.name: Food arrives with identifying photographs on sticks
entities.description: The meals are served under silver covers and revealed to be visually identical lumpy brown dishes, differentiated only by color photographs on sticks that match the menu images.

entities.name: Spiro distributes meals with dramatic flair
entities.description: Spiro lifts the silver covers off the dishes and hands them out with exaggerated ceremony, announcing each course by its number and name to the diners.

entities.name: Shirley silently seeks permission to ask for salt
entities.description: Shirley catches her mother's attention and, after receiving an approving nod, turns to Sam and asks him for salt, indicating restrained family dynamics.

entities.name: Giant eyeballs collectively scan the sky
entities.description: Thousands of enormous eyeballs, each about 10 feet in diameter, are packed together across a vast landscape and simultaneously track Sam and the Girl as they approach a central platform.

entities.name: Sam anchors cage and removes wings on platform
entities.description: After landing on a high platform atop a central column, Sam secures the hawser holding the floating cage and takes off his wings, preparing to reach the Girl.

entities.name: Cracks violently fissure across the sky from horizon
entities.description: A series of loud cracking sounds accompany the rapid appearance of straight fissures in the sky, originating from a vanishing point beyond the horizon and spreading across the entire sky, passing over Sam and the Girl.

entities.name: monolithic stone skyscrapers
entities.description: A cluster of massive stone structures below the rising cage, forming part of the vertical cityscape.

entities.name: platform high atop a column
entities.description: A raised structure situated on a central column in the middle of the eyeball-covered landscape, where Sam lands with the cage.

entities.name: bizarre place
entities.description: The strange, otherworldly environment dominated by giant eyeballs scanning the sky, serving as the primary setting for the scene.

entities.name: Sam Lowry
entities.description: A man in his dream-self form who rescues a girl by towing her in a floating cage to a remote platform, believing it to be a safe place beyond reach of pursuers.
entities.summary: A Records employee, late for work, reflects on his stagnant life while dealing with bureaucratic errors and strange encounters, including a call from Mr. Kurtzman and a mix-up between Buttle and Tuttle, amid malfunctioning systems and surreal events.

entities.name: Girl
entities.description: A female figure imprisoned in a floating cage, being transported by Sam to a secluded platform for safety.

entities.name: Floating Cage
entities.description: A cage that hovers and contains the girl, towed by Sam using wings and later anchored on a platform.
entities.summary: A cage that hovers and contains the girl, towed by Sam using wings and later anchored on a platform.

entities.name: Wings
entities.description: Wings worn by Sam that enable flight and allow him to tow the floating cage through the sky.
entities.summary: Wings worn by Sam that enable flight and allow him to tow the floating cage through the sky.

entities.name: hawser
entities.description: A thick rope or cable used by Sam to secure the floating cage to the platform.

entities.name: pursuers
entities.description: An implied group or force that Sam believes threatens him and the girl, motivating his effort to reach a secure location.

entities.name: Grid of cracks spreads across the sky and blocks of sky begin sliding upward
entities.description: Cracks form at right angles to existing fissures, creating a massive grid across the sky;随后, large square blocks of sky begin to slide upward one by one, leaving dark holes behind.

entities.name: Sam freezes while sky blocks are removed and light diminishes
entities.description: As the blocks of sky are sequentially pulled away, Sam remains immobilized, the light fades with each removal, and the environment grows increasingly dark.

entities.name: Girl cries out for Sam to save her as sky disintegrates
entities.description: Amid the collapse of the sky, the Girl desperately calls out to Sam, pleading for him to rescue her from the unfolding catastrophe.

entities.name: Sam attempts to haul cage down to platform but fails
entities.description: In a frantic effort, Sam tries to pull the floating cage down to the platform to escape the darkness, but he is too late as the last of the sky vanishes.

entities.name: Final block of sky is removed and total blackness ensues
entities.description: The last remaining square of sky is slowly pulled up and out of view, resulting in complete and absolute darkness enveloping the scene.

entities.name: Maniacal laughter echoes and Sam activates searchlight in darkness
entities.description: After the sky vanishes, a sinister laughter is heard; Sam turns on a searchlight in an attempt to illuminate the surrounding blackness.

entities.name: Sam's searchlight beam catches black flapping cloth descending rapidly
entities.description: Sam's light briefly illuminates a large, black, flapping cloth-like object moving through the darkness before it rushes toward him.

entities.name: Black flapping entity engulfs Sam in darkness
entities.description: The black, flapping cloth-like thing crashes down on Sam, completely surrounding and consuming him in a terrifying, oppressive darkness.

entities.name: Searchlight
entities.description: A handheld light source activated by Sam in the darkness after the sky has been completely removed.

document_metadata.title: 21、INT. SAM'S BEDROOM NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Sam suffers in extreme heat, fails to get help from Central Services due to staff shortage, and desperately tries to cool down by sitting in front of an open refrigerator, where he nods off and knocks over a jar of pickled onions.

entities.name: Sam struggles with bedclothes during a night sweat
entities.description: Sam is in bed, visibly distressed, grappling with the bedclothes while drenched in sweat and screaming in a hot room.

entities.name: Sam discovers thermostat is stuck at 99 degrees
entities.description: Sam checks the thermostat in his room, finds it reading 99 degrees, and attempts unsuccessfully to adjust it because it is jammed.

entities.name: Sam attempts to open sealed window in sitting room
entities.description: Sam rushes to the window in the sitting room, only to find it permanently sealed with screws preventing it from opening.

entities.name: Sam uses knife to unscrew and open window
entities.description: Sam retrieves a knife from the kitchen and uses it to remove the screws from the window, allowing him to swing it open.

entities.name: Toxic smog enters apartment through open window
entities.description: After opening the window, Sam is assaulted by a thick greeny-brown smog that floods into the apartment, causing him to gag, cough, and hack violently.

entities.name: Sam seals window against incoming smog
entities.description: In response to the toxic air, Sam quickly closes the window and tightly resecures it with the screws to block the smog from entering.

entities.name: Sam clears air with newspaper to reach front door
entities.description: Using a newspaper as a fan, Sam attempts to disperse the polluted air in the apartment, creating a path that allows him to stagger to the front door.

entities.name: Sam exits apartment into hallway gasping for air
entities.description: Overcome by the poor air quality indoors, Sam stumbles out of his apartment into the hallway, desperately gasping for breathable air.

entities.description: A relative temporal reference indicating the events occur during the night, anchored to the scene's progression.

entities.name: Sam dials Central Services for help with air-conditioning failure
entities.description: Sam, seated in his kitchen with a telephone directory open, calls Central Services to report an issue with his air-conditioning, providing his location and expressing urgency.

entities.name: Central Services automated response rejects Sam's service call
entities.description: Sam's call to Central Services is met with a prerecorded message stating that service calls cannot be taken between 2300 and 0900 due to staff shortages, despite Sam's insistence on the emergency nature of his situation.

entities.description: After being unable to reach a live operator and having his pleas dismissed by the automated system, Sam angrily terminates the call by slamming the phone down.

entities.description: In an attempt to cope with the heat, Sam sits in front of his open refrigerator with a chair wedged into the door gap, using the cold air to cool himself as he begins to fall asleep.

entities.description: As Sam dozes off, his head leans against a shelf inside the open refrigerator, accidentally knocking over a jar of pickled onions, which falls to the floor.

entities.name: Administrative error confuses A. Buttle with A. Tuttle
entities.description: A bureaucratic mix-up occurs between two clients, B58/732 (A. Buttle) and T47/215 (A. Tuttle), leading to the wrongful detention of Buttle due to mistaken identity.

entities.name: Wrongful detention of A. Buttle by authorities
entities.description: A. Buttle is mistakenly apprehended and detained based on false identification, resulting in severe consequences including his death during interrogation.

entities.name: A. Buttle dies during interrogation
entities.description: Due to an undiagnosed heart condition not listed in the transferred file, A. Buttle dies while undergoing interrogation under assumed identity as A. Tuttle.

entities.name: JACK justifies detention and death of A. Buttle
entities.description: JACK argues that he acted in good faith, accepting the delivered individual as the correct suspect according to protocol, and expresses frustration over the systemic error.

entities.name: JACK resolves to capture A. Tuttle for interrogation
entities.description: To correct the bureaucratic error, JACK decides to locate and interrogate the actual suspect, A. Tuttle, under the same conditions applied to Buttle, including matching voltage and record-keeping.

entities.name: A. Tuttle suspected of freelance subversion
entities.description: A. Tuttle, a former Central Service heating engineer, is accused of engaging in unauthorized acts of subversion against the state, motivated by a grudge against society.

entities.name: JACK plans to arrest Layton woman
entities.description: JACK states his intention to apprehend the Layton woman, viewing her arrest as a necessary step toward resolving the current crisis and restoring operational credibility.

document_metadata.summary: Sam confronts a guard who transforms into a giant warrior; after being knocked down, Sam falls into a stone ship where prisoners morph into Baggees as he searches for Jill.

entities.name: Sam confronts Jill with anger over the parcel
entities.description: Sam, overcome with anxiety and anger, accuses Jill of not deserving to be alive and suggests she should have been harmed like the others, gesturing toward the wounded.

entities.name: Jill retrieves and opens the parcel from the debris
entities.description: Jill digs the parcel out of the wreckage, tears open the brown paper, and reveals a dozen brightly colored Christmas packages containing executive toys.

entities.name: Jill throws the parcel at Sam
entities.description: In response to Sam's accusations, Jill hurls the opened parcel and its contents forcefully into Sam's chest, causing him to fall backward into debris.

entities.name: Sam becomes entangled with a shop dummy's severed limbs
entities.description: After being struck by the parcel, Sam topples into the wreckage and gets caught up in the detached limbs of a shop dummy.

entities.name: Liquor spills on Sam's suit from a broken bottle
entities.description: A shattered bottle leaks alcohol onto Sam's clothing, soaking his suit as he sits in the debris, emotionally overwhelmed.

entities.name: Jill attends to the bomb victims
entities.description: Hearing moans from the injured, Jill shifts her attention to the wounded individuals and begins attempting to comfort them.

entities.name: Jill orders Sam to help the injured
entities.description: Jill tells Sam to stop being passive and assist in aiding the hurt victims, prompting him to join her in providing help.

entities.name: Sam uses his jacket as a pillow for a victim
entities.description: Sam removes his jacket, which bears an Information Retrieval badge, and places it under the head of one of the injured to make them more comfortable.

entities.name: Sirens wail and sprinklers activate in the aftermath
entities.description: Emergency sirens begin sounding and water sprinklers turn on, contributing to the chaotic environment following the explosion.

entities.name: Security guards arrest everyone at the scene
entities.description: Security personnel arrive and start detaining all individuals present, including the injured and even the deceased.

entities.name: Security guard assaults Jill
entities.description: When a guard attempts to drag away a wounded woman Jill is helping, she protests, and the guard responds by striking her in the face with his gloved hand.

entities.name: Sam reacts violently to the guard's assault on Jill
entities.description: Witnessing the guard hit Jill, Sam becomes enraged and shouts at the guard to stop, marking a turning point in his emotional state.

entities.name: debris
entities.description: The scattered wreckage at the scene where the parcel is found and events unfold.

entities.name: Sam Lowry
entities.description: A man experiencing anxiety and anger who becomes involved in a confrontation over a suspicious parcel and later helps bomb victims.
entities.summary: A Records employee, late for work, reflects on his stagnant life while dealing with bureaucratic errors and strange encounters, including a call from Mr. Kurtzman and a mix-up between Buttle and Tuttle, amid malfunctioning systems and surreal events.

entities.name: Jill Layton
entities.description: A woman who retrieves and opens a suspicious parcel, defends the injured, and is assaulted by a security guard.
entities.summary: A woman connected to Buttle's flat is observed in multiple instances—questioning officials, entering the building, appearing in a ceiling hole, and fleeing a burning car—drawing Sam's attention due to her resemblance to a dream image and expressing concern for others.

entities.name: executive toys
entities.description: A collection of novelty items wrapped as Christmas gifts, revealed to be the contents of the parcel.

entities.name: broken bottle
entities.description: A shattered container from which liquor spills onto Sam's suit during the aftermath of an explosion.

entities.name: shop dummy's severed limbs
entities.description: Detached artificial limbs from a mannequin that Sam becomes entangled with after being knocked over.

entities.name: jacket
entities.description: Sam's outer garment, bearing an Information Retrieval badge, used as a pillow for an injured victim.

entities.name: Information Retrieval badge
entities.description: An identification badge attached to Sam's jacket, indicating his affiliation or role.

entities.name: security guard
entities.description: A guard who arrives at the scene, arrests individuals including the injured, and assaults Jill when she intervenes.

entities.name: bomb victims
entities.description: Injured individuals at the scene who are attended to by Jill and Sam after an explosion.

entities.name: injured
entities.description: People wounded in the explosion who are being cared for and are targeted for arrest by security guards.

entities.name: official ass-holes
entities.description: A derogatory term used by Jill to refer to bureaucratic or authoritarian figures like Sam, implying systemic corruption or incompetence.

entities.name: Security guard transforms into the Giant Warrior from Sam's dream
entities.description: The security guard undergoes a surreal transformation into the Giant Warrior that Sam had previously seen in a dream, towering over the wounded, dying, and debris in the lingerie department.

entities.name: Sam grabs a detached shop dummy arm as a weapon
entities.description: In response to the transformed guard, Sam seizes one of the detached arms of a shop dummy, using it as an improvised club to prepare for combat.

entities.name: Jill shouts at Sam to stop
entities.description: As Sam prepares to fight the transformed guard, Jill urgently calls out to him, attempting to prevent the confrontation.

entities.name: Sam and the Giant Warrior face off in combat stance
entities.description: Sam and the Giant Warrior assume opposing combat positions, each searching for an opening or weakness in the other's defense.

entities.name: Sam is struck from behind by a trooper's gun butt
entities.description: Just as Sam is about to engage the Giant Warrior, he is knocked down by a blow to the back of the head from a trooper's firearm.

entities.name: Sam falls down the inner wall of the stone ship
entities.description: Sam tumbles uncontrollably down the steep inner surface of the stone ship, crashing repeatedly until he reaches the bottom.

entities.name: Sam lands at the bottom of the stone ship and is confronted by grey prisoners
entities.description: After his fall, Sam lies injured at the base of the stone ship, where he is surrounded by silent, looming grey prisoners.

entities.name: Sam weakly asks the grey prisoners about Jill's location
entities.description: Injured and disoriented, Sam struggles to speak and asks the grey prisoners if Jill is present.

entities.name: Grey prisoners dissolve into baggees
entities.description: The grey prisoners surrounding Sam undergo a transformation, dissolving into the form of several baggees.

entities.name: blasted lingerie department
entities.description: A destroyed retail section within a store, specifically identified as the lingerie department, where the confrontation and transformation occur.

entities.name: stone ship
entities.description: An interior stone structure resembling a ship, where Sam falls and lands at the bottom, encountering the grey prisoners.

entities.name: ANTI-DAY

entities.description: A military or security enforcer who attacks Sam from behind with a gun butt during the confrontation with the Giant Warrior.

entities.name: grey prisoners
entities.description: Mysterious figures encountered by Sam at the bottom of the stone ship who initially appear as prisoners but later transform into baggees.

entities.name: baggees
entities.description: Strange, amorphous entities formed when the grey prisoners dissolve; appear to be a recurring or symbolic presence in Sam's surreal experience.

entities.name: gun butt
entities.description: The butt of a trooper's firearm used to strike Sam from behind, knocking him down during the combat standoff.

document_metadata.title: 99、INT. BLACK MARIA EVENING
document_metadata.summary: Sam regains consciousness, searches frantically among BAGGEES for Jill, is stopped by guards enforcing regulations, and is knocked out by Guard A.

entities.name: Guards complain about helmet discomfort during transport
entities.description: Two guards remove their helmets and discuss how the helmets cause itching and sweating, impairing their vision and comfort while traveling back to base.

entities.name: Sam stirs and groans while lying on the floor of the Black Maria
entities.description: Sam, dazed and partially covered by his jacket, shows signs of consciousness by moving and making sounds, drawing attention from the guards.

entities.name: Guards observe Sam and question his presence
entities.description: One guard notices Sam's movement and asks who he is, prompting another to remark on his unusual appearance and affiliation with Information Retrieval.

entities.description: A routine post-operation transfer involving the movement of detainees and personnel in a secure vehicle, during which guards are relaxing and monitoring a lone detainee.

entities.summary: A Records employee, late for work, reflects on his stagnant life while dealing with bureaucratic errors and strange encounters, including a call from Mr. Kurtzman and a mix-up between Buttle and Tuttle, amid malfunctioning systems and surreal events.

entities.description: A department or organizational unit to which Sam belongs, referenced by one of the guards.
entities.summary: Sam has been promoted within a bureaucratic or intelligence department in the Ministry of Information, where Mr Helpmann works and personnel code discrepancies occur; this department classifies individuals as inoperative and is searching for Archibald Tuttle, contrasting with Jack's career path.

entities.name: BAGGEEs
entities.description: Suspension devices or restraints hanging from a ceiling track in the Black Maria, used to secure individuals during transport.

entities.name: Sam regains consciousness and searches for Jill among the BAGGEEs
entities.description: Sam wakes up, observes the BAGGEEs around him, and begins frantically searching through them, checking inside their hoods, looking for a girl named Jill.

entities.name: Guard A warns Sam not to tamper with BAGGEEs as they are government property
entities.description: Guard A intervenes and tells Sam that the BAGGEEs are government property and should not be handled.

entities.name: Sam urgently asks Guard A about a girl with specific features
entities.description: Sam asks Guard A if a tall girl with fair hair and blue eyes is present, indicating his concern for Jill's whereabouts.

entities.name: Guard restrains Sam during his search of the BAGGEEs
entities.description: A guard physically pulls Sam back, preventing him from continuing to search the BAGGEEs, citing job-related risks.

entities.name: Sam resists the guard and continues calling for Jill
entities.description: Sam shakes off the guard's restraint and persists in his desperate attempt to find Jill by shouting her name.

entities.name: Guard A strikes Sam, knocking him unconscious again
entities.description: In response to Sam's continued defiance, Guard A hits him, causing him to lose consciousness once more, citing regulations as justification.

entities.name: Guard A apologizes to Sam after knocking him out
entities.description: After striking Sam, Guard A expresses regret, explaining the action was required by regulations, and reassures that Sam will be returned to his office safely.

document_metadata.title: 100、INT. SAM'S OFFICE EVENING
document_metadata.summary: SAM, overwhelmed, sends his paperwork through a pneumatic tube system; it returns, then stops. The tubes pulsate, his desk moves through the wall, and a muffled explosion occurs outside his office.

entities.name: Mr Warren confronts Sam about departmental reputation and unresolved tasks
entities.description: Mr Warren physically restrains Sam by the throat and reprimands him for damaging the department's reputation, citing unresolved issues such as an unaccounted convoy of troop carriers and a disorganized desk filled with pending administrative forms.
